nom: PEACH & LILY Matcha Pudding Antioxidant Cream

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cream can feel heavy and greasy or cause breakouts, though others with oily/combination skin say it hydrates without adding shine.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including those with lupus or winter-related flaking, frequently credit this cream with resolving persistent dryness, flaky patches, and peeling.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are split: many say it balances dry cheeks and oily zones without heaviness, while a few found it too rich and reported breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers describing sensitive skin report the cream calms their skin without stinging or breakouts, but a minority with sensitive/reactive skin describe strong stinging, tightness, or a rosacea flare.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s–60s report brighter, plumper-looking skin and reduced fine lines, with no major complaints tied specifically to mature skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers over 40–60 report smoother texture and diminished fine lines, especially around the eyes; no dissent noted on this point.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers say the cream resolves dryness, flaking, and peeling, particularly in winter; several others report the opposite, saying hydration is short-lived and skin feels dry again within hours.
concerns.redness: Numerous reviewers, several with rosacea, report visibly reduced redness and calmer skin over time; one reviewer instead reports redness became worse after use.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers mention the cream soothing skin after laser treatment, microneedling, or tretinoin-related peeling without worsening irritation.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports dark spots left after a breakout caused by the product, while another reports small bumps and pimples reducing after use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including one whose daughter uses prescription acne medication, report no breakouts and reduced blemishes; others describe new cystic acne, pus-filled bumps, or scarring after use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin are divided: some say it leaves skin shine-free and matte-feeling, while others say it makes oily skin greasier by end of day.

extraits.texte: I was so excited to try this out. I had been using the la roche possay double repair moisturizer, but I had a gift card and wanted something a little nicer & that would help with redness. Ive never reallt struggled with acne but I noticed after using this for awhile that I was starting to develop cystic acne on my neck and hairline. I even started to get this large pus filled bumps on my cheeks that looked like bug bites- Ive never had acne line that before. I wasnt sure if it was stress/diet related, so I took a break from this mousturizer for awhile and gave my skin time to heal. After recently using this product again over the last few weeks, I can confirm this is the source of my inflamed breakouts :(. Ive been using this again for about 3-4 weeks and a few days ago developed more neck acne and 2 more of those pus filled papules on my cheeks! The last one even left a scar :(. Do not buy this, it has a comedogenic formula and I didnt notice any help with redness (it def made my red areas worse).

I am someone with sensitive skin and bought this because it is touted as being safe for that. Firstly, it says fragrance free, it is 100% percent not fragrance free, (they probably mean that it doesn't have artificial fragrance). It smell way too strong and very unpleasant. Second, I applied this product and 2 minutes passed and I could feel my skin feel super tight (not moisturized in the slightest). Then, 4 minutes passed amd I started feeling a kind of menthol, stinging sensation on my face. I decided to rush and wash my face immediately. I just had it on for 5 minutes before I washed it off and that same day my face freaked out with red spots and tiny white heads (which is a sign of a rosacea flare). I'm writing this 3 days later amd my face has gotten even worse. I would never recommend this product. I will stick with my Vanicream and Eucerin, never had a single problem with those.

extraits.titre: Nice but not for oily skin
extraits.texte: I was kind of pressured into buying this by an employee on black friday. I dont know much about the brand, other than its pretty expensive. I'm somehow 47 now ughhhh, with oily skin & no wrinkles - thank god. I have some small crows feet around my eyes though. Like every other woman on earth, im always down for a new moisturizer; so i figured why not? The product has a nice consistency, a surprising green color which was intriguing & goes on very smooth. However, this is WAY too heavy with my oily skin. I've decided to keep it though because i noticed a change in hydration and appearance around my eyes insantly. Ive only used it about 4 times now; just around my eyes and they keep looking better and better. Its a really nice moisturizer for anyone with dry skin for sure, but if you have oily skin, this will likely make you look like a grease pit and potentially break you out.

This product along with the glass skin serum are my HG. I've struggled with redness and splotchiness for years, but my skin improved overnight after using these products. The longer I use them, the better my skin looks. I have combination skin, and I find that the matcha pudding is moisturizing but also not too heavy. It absorbs right into my skin and leaves me feeling soft without being oily. A little goes a long way, so it is worth the price. It also smells sooo good! But I wouldn't recommend it to people sensitive to essential oils as I've heard it has some in it. I have sensitive skin and it's only helped me though, but I don't think im sensitive to essential oil.

I've been using the Matcha Pudding Antioxidant Cream daily, and I just ran out — immediately ordered the largest size because I can't imagine my skincare routine without it! This cream spreads beautifully, absorbs perfectly, and never leaves my skin feeling oily or heavy. It's lightweight but still deeply hydrating. What truly sets it apart for me is how much it's helped calm my rosacea. My skin feels soothed and balanced, with noticeably less redness and irritation. Plus, it smells so nice — fresh and clean without being overpowering. And as always, the shipping was fast and reliable. Can't recommend it enough!

This product is AMAZING! I get very dry skin on my face during winter and tend to peel a lot (like a lot, a lot) this moisturizer is a 10/10! Its reduced the dry, flaky skin on my T-zone exceptionally! Almost completely gone in a matter of days! It has absolutely saved my face! Definitely my new go to for winter time.

Ive been usung this for about 2 weeks and used it after microneedling my face and it didn't irritate my skin and even calmed my skin after using it. I see it doesnt agree with some people's skin, could be allergies or something, but i have a combination skin type normal to oily. My usual moisturizer (cerave pm), I layered it with this moisturizer and it made my skin baby smooth the next morning. I think the antioxidants and this is really helping my skin prevent breakouts. Because I have really oily skin on areas on my face, I need a good moisturizer to really hydrate after using strong cleansers and this has been moisturizing my skin the best out of any moisturizer I've used. Personally, I love this and I would recommend this to anyone, but if you have very sensitive skin, I would ask a dermatologist first or make sure you're not allergic to any of the ingredients.
